## Pull request overview

This PR fixes failing Storybook tests for the `page` and `object-grid` JSON stories by ensuring the runtime schema context is provided via `SchemaRendererProvider` from `@object-ui/react`, matching patterns used in other stories.

**Changes:**
- Updated `page.stories.tsx` and `object-grid.stories.tsx` to import `SchemaRenderer` and `SchemaRendererProvider` from `@object-ui/react` instead of the local `SchemaRenderer`.
- Wrapped the stories’ render functions in `SchemaRendererProvider` with a `dataSource` prop (an empty object), so nested components that call `useDataScope()` / `useSchemaContext()` no longer throw.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `packages/components/src/stories-json/page.stories.tsx` | Switches to the `@object-ui/react` `SchemaRenderer` and wraps it in `SchemaRendererProvider` to provide context for nested components like `data-table`. |
| `packages/components/src/stories-json/object-grid.stories.tsx` | Uses `SchemaRenderer`/`SchemaRendererProvider` from `@object-ui/react` and wraps the shared `renderStory` helper so `object-grid` stories run under a proper schema context. |
